description: Resources for Cyclone Anthony and Cyclone Yasi, north Queensland (January-February 2011) is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Australian Ocean Data Network. Cyclone Anthony and Cyclone Yasi impacted the North Queensland coast during January and February 2011. Anthony, a category 2 storm crossed near Bowen on the 30th January. Yasi, a large category 5 system crossed the coast around midnight on 2nd February between Mission Beach and Cardwell. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Australian Ocean Data Network. It offers 9 resource(s) in html, jpeg, png, xlsx. The portal shows 2026-01-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
